build-and-check.text: Build the pinned documentation package with Nix. Flake checks validate rendered links, anchors, speech data and required pages, not protocol behavior.

edit-and-serve.text: Use the Nix development shell for a strict MkDocs build or live local server. A separate CI build verifies that shell.

publication-and-accessibility.text: Pull requests have a live preview without comments. Main publishes through GitHub Pages. The site includes a theme toggle and section read-aloud controls using browser voices.

Diagrams are Mermaid, rendered by the copy the shared toolchain pins as a Nix input and served from the site itself. No page loads a script or stylesheet from outside the site, and the site check fails if one does.

documentation-releases.text: At this bootstrap revision, no documentation version is released. The unreleased baseline is zero point zero point zero. Release-please proposes version changes in a pull request. An operator-authorized version tag on its merged commit publishes the Nix-built documentation archive and checksum, verifies uploaded bytes, then updates bookkeeping labels without comments.
